What is the purpose of your investment?

Active investment

Outstanding Amount

The value of all your active investments. This is the amount you will receive if holding the investments till maturity. This excludes already sold or matured investments.

Outstanding Amount = (Invested + Gains) − Repaid
Total Invested

Total amount invested in all your active investments.

Gains10.75% YTM

Total gains from your active investments, including interest that has been repaid and accrued

Repaid

Total amount repaid to you across all your active investments including both interest and principal repayment

Lifetime investment

YTM Earned

The weighted XIRR returns from all your investments which has been matured

Total Invested

Total amount invested in all your lifetime investments, including active, matured, and sold investments.

Gains10.75% YTM

Total gains from your lifetime investments, including interest that has been repaid and accrued

Repaid

Total amount repaid to you across all your lifetime investments, including matured and sold investments.
